verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the document-assembly rule that the table of contents is completed only after the magazine layout and pagination are finalized.
The client explicitly requires the table of contents to display page numbers matching the finalized magazine pagination.
First concrete failure: the client reviewed the document and found the table of contents inaccurate because final pagination was not yet reflected.
The client makes accurate table-of-contents information a concrete acceptance condition for finalizing the magazine.
